response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id), f AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, CAST(film_count AS REAL) / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM c) SELECT actor_id, film_count, fraction, fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM f ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
